features: High Storage Capacity with Full Height Expansion Slot
4U chassis support for SMCI Proprietary WIO motherboards; max. motherboard size - 12" x 13", 13" x 13.68" * Support up to 12"x13" MB with rear 2.5" HDD option installed
36 x 3.5" hot-swap drive bay, optional 2 x 2.5" hot-swap drive bay

12-port 2U SAS3 12Gbps dual-expander backplane, support up to 12x 3.5-inch SAS3/SATA3 HDD/SSD (secondary expander port only connects to dual-port SAS devices, single-port SATA will not have this redundancy feature) 24-port 4U SAS3 12Gbps dual-expander backplane, support up to 24x 3.5-inch SAS3/SATA3 HDD/SSD (secondary expander port only connects to dual-port SAS devices, single-port SATA will not have this redundancy feature)
7 x 8cm (7000 RPM) hot-swap PWM cooling fan(s)
